description: The line plot illustrates the time cost in seconds for two different configurations—labeled "w/o Pre-computation" (blue line) and "w/ Pre-computation" (orange line)—as a function of the paper number, which ranges from 1 to 256 on a logarithmic scale. The y-axis, representing time cost, is scaled from 0 to 35 seconds. The blue line, corresponding to the "w/o Pre-computation" case, begins at approximately 1 second for paper number 1 and exhibits a steep, non-linear increase, reaching over 35 seconds by paper number 256. In contrast, the orange line, representing the "w/ Pre-computation" case, remains nearly flat and close to 0 seconds across the entire range of paper numbers, indicating a significantly lower and stable time cost. The plot clearly demonstrates that pre-computation drastically reduces the time cost compared to the scenario without it.
